fig1_dielectric_screening.svg: A free point charge (1 nC) embedded in a linear dielectric. The displacement D is set by the free charge alone (medium-independent), so the actual field E = D/eps = E_vac/eps_r is reduced by 1/eps_r: higher eps_r screens the field more.
fig2_polarized_sphere_bound_charge.svg: Bound surface charge on a uniformly polarized sphere with P along z: sigma_b(theta) = P cos(theta), positive on the north cap and negative on the south. This bound charge sources the uniform depolarizing field E = -P/3eps0 inside.
